item.title: Council condemns mindless tree vandalism – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton Council has condemned vandals who ripped up scores of tree saplings on land close to Hall I’th’ Wood museum.

item.title: Council consults on extending ‘No moor fires’ ban – Bolton Council
item.description: A ban on barbeques, campfires, sky lanterns and fireworks on moorlands around Bolton is up for review.

item.title: Welcome to Bolton: Making our town centre safer for everyone – Bolton Council
item.description: From easier navigation to improved lighting, Bolton Council is investing in a safer town centre for residents, workers and visitors.

item.title: Unique experiences to treat the mums in your life to this Mother’s Day – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s award winning Food and Drink Festival is gearing up for another unforgettable year - and just in time for Mother’s Day, one of its most popular ticketed events has officially gone on sale.

item.title: New bus services hailed by council – Bolton Council
item.description: New bus services are set to link Bolton town centre with Middlebrook for the first time and make getting to and from Logistics North easier for people who work there.

item.title: Crompton Place developers set out vision for Bolton’s future – Bolton Council
item.description: More than 200 representatives from local businesses heard how the redevelopment of Crompton Place marks an exciting new phase in Bolton’s regeneration.

item.title: Homecoming for Bolton’s iconic elephants – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s iconic elephants will make a triumphant return as the council aims to guarantee everyone a warm welcome to the town centre.

item.title: Bolton launches the 2040 Vision – Bolton Council
item.description: The Bolton Vision Partnership has officially launched the Bolton 2040 Vision (The Borough Plan), a roadmap to transform the community into one where everybody can thrive.

item.title: Bolton’s Sleeper Pod scheme judged a success – Bolton Council
item.description: As Bolton’s Sleeper Pod test draws to an end, its former homeless residents have praised the life-changing opportunities it provided them.

item.title: New Youth MPs announced for Bolton – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s new Youth MPs have been elected after young people across Bolton cast their vote for candidates at the Youth MP Elections 2026.
